text: Roasted squash soup as the starter on the autumn menu.
reason: Squash is at its cheapest in October and the soup holds well across two services.
rejected: A chilled gazpacho, which is out of season and sells poorly once the evenings turn cold.

text: Mushroom and leek pie as the vegetarian main on the autumn menu.
reason: The kitchen already makes the pastry for the beef pie, so the new main adds no new prep.
rejected: A risotto, which keeps a cook at the stove for twenty minutes during service.

text: Pear and almond tart as the dessert on the autumn menu.
reason: Pears arrive in September and the tart bakes ahead in the morning.
rejected: A souffle, which cannot be made ahead.

text: Should the roast chicken stay on the autumn menu, or come off to make room for a braise?
reason: It is the top seller, but a braise would reuse the squash and mushrooms already on order.
